concepts.label: SQL index
concepts.description: Indexes can accelerate selected access patterns but add storage and write maintenance cost.

concepts.label: SQL query plan
concepts.description: Execution plans describe chosen scans, joins and data-access operations.

concepts.label: Transaction isolation
concepts.description: Isolation levels constrain how transactions observe concurrent changes.

concepts.label: Database locking
concepts.description: Locks coordinate concurrent operations over database rows, tables or metadata.

concepts.label: Object relational mapping
concepts.description: ORMs translate object-level queries and associations to database operations.

concepts.label: ETL pipeline
concepts.description: Extract-transform-load pipelines move and transform data between systems.

concepts.label: Schema migration
concepts.description: Database migrations change persisted schemas with controlled rollout and compatibility.

concepts.label: Document Object Model
concepts.description: The DOM represents document nodes and provides APIs to inspect or change them.

concepts.label: Reactive state updates
concepts.description: Reactive frameworks propagate state changes to dependent computations or views.

concepts.label: Client hydration
concepts.description: Hydration attaches interactive runtime behavior to pre-rendered HTML output.

concepts.label: Single-page application
concepts.description: An SPA updates content through client-side navigation without full page reloads.

concepts.label: WebSocket communication
concepts.description: WebSockets provide bidirectional connections after a protocol handshake.

concepts.label: GraphQL schema
concepts.description: GraphQL schemas define types, operations and fields for graph-oriented APIs.

concepts.label: Model training
concepts.description: Training adjusts model parameters to optimize a loss over training data.

concepts.label: Model inference
concepts.description: Inference applies learned parameters to inputs to produce outputs.

concepts.label: Fine-tuning
concepts.description: Fine-tuning adapts pretrained model parameters or adapters to a downstream task.

concepts.label: Vector embeddings
concepts.description: Embeddings encode inputs into numeric vectors useful for similarity matching.

concepts.label: Retrieval-augmented generation
concepts.description: RAG supplies retrieved material as grounding context for a generative model.

concepts.label: ONNX model format
concepts.description: ONNX represents computation graphs for interoperability across supported runtimes.

concepts.label: Model quantization
concepts.description: Quantization uses reduced numeric precision to reduce storage or computation cost.
